params.style_prompt: 16-bit pixel art, flat colors, clean crisp pixels, vibrant

card.architecture: Flux-dev img2img with per-step pixel-manifold projection (PixelManifoldProjection patch + PixelQuantize final render)
card.summary: The diffusion pixelizer: redraws an image into clean pixel art while clamping the x0 estimate onto a fixed grid+palette every denoise step. Flux-dev is a neutral high-fidelity denoiser (it does not author the art); low strength + strong projection ramp let the quantizer lead. API-only.
use_cases: high-quality pixelization of a hero still
redraw-style pixel art where plain quantization would be mushy
card.pick_when: Quality pixelization of a single still where a diffusion redraw beats a straight quantize.
